title: SREV-065 SCM sppsvc handle lifetime contract

scm_handle.description: SCM database handle returned by Scm_OpenSCManagerW

service_handle.description: sppsvc service handle returned by Scm_OpenServiceWImpl

cleanup.description: CloseServiceHandle ownership release for opened SCM/service handles

contracts: Handles returned by OpenSCManagerW and OpenServiceW are SCM/service object handles
SCM and service object handles must be closed with CloseServiceHandle when no longer needed
Scm_Start_Sppsvc owns both handle1 and handle2 until its cleanup block
The service handle returned by Scm_OpenServiceWImpl must be assigned to the outer handle2 lifetime slot
A nested handle2 declaration must not shadow the cleanup-owned service handle
